title: Base Diagnostics variant 5
purpose: Exercise a canonical Modbus Diagnostics request with a standard return-query-data subfunction and a zero data value.
expected_behavior: A conforming server may parse the request and return a Diagnostics response for unit 05, commonly echoing the subfunction and data; unsupported diagnostics may produce a protocol exception response.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0007 equals the unit identifier plus the 6-byte PDU.
Function code 08, subfunction 0000, and 0000 data are ordered consistently.
issue_safety_notes: No external vulnerability or issue knowledge is available. This is a conservative model-prior seed intended for parsing and functional coverage, not an issue reproduction.
